actions.description: Choose "Account": The account the order trades in.

value.description: The option to choose: cash = Cash; margin = Margin

actions.name: ticket_account
actions.title: Account

actions.description: Turn on or off "Confirm each fill": Whether each fill asks for confirmation.

value.description: true to turn it on, false to turn it off

actions.name: ticket_confirm_fill
actions.title: Confirm each fill

actions.description: Turn on or off "Extended hours": Whether the order may fill outside regular trading hours.

value.description: true to turn it on, false to turn it off

actions.name: ticket_extended_hours
actions.title: Extended hours

actions.description: Select a tab of "Panel": Which part of the ticket is shown.

value.description: The tab to select: ticket = Ticket; orders = Open orders

actions.name: ticket_panel
actions.title: Panel

actions.description: Choose "Side": Whether the order buys or sells.

value.description: The option to choose: buy = Buy; sell = Sell

actions.name: ticket_side
actions.title: Side

observations.description: What the page shows now. values: ticket.account (Account), ticket.side (Side), ticket.extended-hours (Extended hours), ticket.confirm-fill (Confirm each fill), ticket.panel (Panel).
